limitation: A 50-pair sample at the recorded threshold, not model ground truth or a measurement of unlinked-record recall.
precision_basis: Conservative confirmed-correct fraction of all 50 supplied reviews; uncertain is nonconfirmed, never correct. Precision is null until all 50 decisions and reviewer names are supplied.
judgment_origin: Reviewer-supplied CSV judgments. This script generates no judgments and cannot attest that the entries were made by a human.
